title: EKS Extended Support Pricing: What $0.60 an Hour Means for Your Fleet from 1 April
excerpt: From April 2024 an EKS cluster in extended support costs $0.60 an hour instead of $0.10. A fleet audit and day-by-day cost model show why upgrading 1.24 to 1.25 saves only $360 a year, and why the plan has to reach 1.28 or 1.29.
